summary: John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund (JHCPIF) filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its June 22, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Manulife Private Credit Fund (MPCF) via wholly-owned Merger Sub. The September 29, 2026 Amendment No. 1 provides that fractional Acquiror Class I Common Shares will be issued with no cash in lieu, and book-entry holders need not deliver letters of transmittal; the Exchange Agent will credit accounts and mail transaction notices. Separately, an expense limitation agreement caps JHCPIF operating expenses at 0.80% of monthly net assets. Deal terms, premium and board recommendation were not specified in the excerpt; watch for shareholder vote and closing timeline.
